entities.name: Query protein 530 aa
observations: Sequence length is 530 aa with predicted CTP_synth_N domain at residues 3–265 and GATase domain at residues 300–520.
Closest reviewed homolog is Aquifex aeolicus CTP synthase UniProt O67353: 74.2% identity, 98.7% query coverage, E-value 1.18e-300.
Additional reviewed CTP synthase homologs B4U6A9 and Q8R720 show 65.5% and 60.5% identity over approximately 99% coverage.
Sequence-based assignment is strong homology support, not a direct biochemical assay of this query protein.

entities.name: CTP synthase O67353
observations: Reviewed Aquifex aeolicus CTP synthase, EC 6.3.4.2; annotated as ATP-dependent amination of UTP to CTP using L-glutamine or ammonia as nitrogen source.
Annotated as a homotetramer and involved in de novo CTP biosynthesis.
GTP activates the glutamine-dependent reaction; CTP inhibits allosterically according to the reviewed annotation.

entities.name: CTP synthase glutamine reaction
observations: Overall reaction: UTP + L-glutamine + ATP + H2O → CTP + L-glutamate + ADP + phosphate + 2 H(+).
Rhea identifier RHEA:26426; EC 6.3.4.2 in close reviewed homologs.

entities.name: CTP synthase ammonia reaction
observations: Alternative overall reaction: UTP + NH4(+) + ATP → CTP + ADP + phosphate + 2 H(+).
Rhea identifier RHEA:16597; close homologs are annotated to use ammonia as an alternative nitrogen source.

entities.name: Glutaminase half-reaction
observations: Glutamine amidase module hydrolyzes L-glutamine + H2O → L-glutamate + NH4(+).
Rhea identifier RHEA:15889; the query contains the corresponding C-terminal GATase domain and Pfam Peptidase_C26 region.
